title: 第6章 武道真丹领域

content_zh:
但随即，姜辰立刻明白，即便是原来的姜辰，都觉得姜宁儿无情，更遑论是外人呢？
姜辰目光温和的看向姜韵，同时抽出自己的手，反而双手将姜韵的手握在手心。
这一举动，让姜韵微微一震，俏脸竟是莫名的多了一点红晕。
但，她很镇定的掩饰了那一刹那的慌乱之意，反而瞪了姜辰一眼，似乎姜辰这般举动，太轻浮。
姜辰没有在意姜韵的举动，反而目光真诚、坚定的道：“姜韵师姐，宁儿的一切，都是身不由己，都是为了激励我的斗志，让我不至于颓废。而与古昊的关系的事情，更是身不由己，乃是为了为我求得造化丹，恢复我伤势而不得已为之。她是一个好女孩，你别再误会她了。”
姜辰的话，让姜韵怔然。
随即，姜韵紫衣纱裙忽然无风自动，簌簌飞舞了起来。
姜韵，生气了！
“姜辰！你怎么还是这样，这样的固执！这样的自以为然！你知道姜宁儿是什么天赋吗？是绝世体质的天赋！是上古太清体！就是这种体质，在万雪宫之中，地位就堪比客卿、供奉，长老一般！造化丹虽然珍贵，可她想要，根本不需要任何付出就能得到！”
“也只有你这种傻子，才这么相信她！”
“姜辰！你听我的话，当初，我就告诉你林雪瑶心机太重，你不听！如今我告诉你，姜宁儿绝没有你想的那么简单，你——！”
姜韵说着，狠狠的一挥手，将姜辰裹着她素手的手直接震开。
接着，她的素手指向姜辰，那葱白般的玉指恨不得戳到姜辰的眉心上。
这是怒其不争啊！
“姜韵师姐，我历经未婚妻算计，一朝家破人亡，天赋毁灭，又怎会还看不清现状。但这次，姜韵师姐不论你相信与否，我的心，都不会改变。
姜韵师姐，这件事，也不必多说了。宁儿是我妹，我会一辈子好好的守护她的。”
姜辰沉吟片刻，目光深邃了几分，语气坚决。
“姜辰，你——你简直是，唉，算了，你说得对，你有你的选择。你若能改，你便不是你了。”
姜韵无力的叹息了一声，美丽的眸光里，隐藏不住失望之色。
“姜辰，你以后有什么难处，来找我吧。如你所说，我不仅是你师姐，还是你堂姐。”

“虽然你被逐出了宗门，也被逐出了家族，但你始终是我姜韵的弟弟。”
姜韵再次叹息一声，伸出手来，轻轻的抚了一下姜辰的脸。
姜韵竟是觉得姜辰的脸蛋儿格外的柔，如吹弹可破，极为舒服！
她竟是忍不住多抚了两下。
“师姐，你这样占我的便宜，可是不好的。”
姜辰笑道。
“噗嗤——”
姜韵忽然笑了，随即伸手戳了姜辰的额头一下，笑道：“姜辰，没想到你竟是都会开姐姐的玩笑了，不过这样挺好的，感觉很亲切，不像是原来那样，始终都觉得我们之间相距很远。”
姜韵虽然被说破有点儿不好意思，不过因为笑了，反而与姜辰的关系立刻亲近了许多。
或许，那种严肃的说教，她自己潜意识里也是不喜欢的。
姜辰也笑道：“师姐，虽然说你不笑的时候已经很迷人了，但笑的时候，却更漂亮了。所以，师姐你还是多笑笑的好。”
姜韵闻言，再次的狠狠的瞪了姜辰一眼，道：“油嘴滑舌！看样子，你这是恢复了伤势，真的从过去……走出来了。这样很好。以后，有什么不懂的就问我吧！如果你不介意旁人的眼光的话，我带你去天剑宗，每天指导你修炼。”
姜辰笑道：“天剑宗就算了。师姐你有什么不懂的，不如问我吧，我会好好指导你的。”
“姜辰，你竟还会吹嘘了，这样真的好吗？”
“师姐……虽然说我三年没修炼，但是悟性终究在那儿呢。师姐可不能看不起我。”
“可是，你师姐我如今都已经踏入了修炼的第二大领域——武道真丹领域了呢，真元境第四重圆满，姜辰弟弟，你怎么教我呢？”
姜辰微微皱眉，道：“修炼第二大领域？”
姜韵解释道：“是的，这是我入真元境之后才获得的知识。修炼，被真正的强者划分成为两大领域，为武者入门领域和武道真丹领域两大类。像是之前的后天武者境，先天紫气境，就属于武者入门领域。
而真元境，天元境等境界，则属于武道真丹领域。不过武道真丹领域不仅有真元境，天元境，好像还有虚丹境等境界，具体我就不知了。”

content_en:
But then, Jiang Chen immediately understood that even the original Jiang Chen thought Jiang Ning'er was heartless, let alone an outsider?
Jiang Chen looked at Jiang Yun with gentle eyes, and at the same time took out his hand, and instead held Jiang Yun's hand in his palm.
This move shocked Jiang Yun slightly, and her pretty face turned a little red inexplicably.
However, she calmly concealed her panic at that moment, and instead glared at Jiang Chen, as if Jiang Chen's behavior was too frivolous.
Jiang Chen didn't pay attention to Jiang Yun's actions. Instead, he said with a sincere and firm look: "Senior Sister Jiang Yun, everything Ning'er does is out of control. It is all to stimulate my fighting spirit and prevent me from being decadent. And the relationship with Gu Hao is even more out of control. It is because she has to do it to get the Good Fortune Pill for me and restore my injuries. She is a good girl, don't misunderstand her again."
Jiang Chen's words made Jiang Yun stunned.
Immediately, Jiang Yun's purple gauze skirt suddenly started to flutter automatically without any wind.
Jiang Yun is angry!
"Jiang Chen! Why are you still like this, so stubborn! So self-righteous! Do you know what kind of talent Jiang Ning'er has? It's the talent of a peerless physique! It's the ancient Tai Qing Physique! With this kind of physique, her status in Wanxue Palace is comparable to that of a guest, a worshiper, or an elder! Although the Creation Pill is precious, she can get it without any effort at all if she wants it!"
"Only a fool like you can believe her so much!"
"Jiang Chen! You listen to me. Back then, I told you that Lin Xueyao was too scheming, but you didn't listen! Now I'm telling you, Jiang Ning'er is definitely not as simple as you think, you -!"
Jiang Yun said, and with a fierce wave of her hand, Jiang Chen's hand wrapped around her bare hand was shaken away.
Then, she pointed her bare finger at Jiang Chen, and her green-white jade finger wanted to poke Jiang Chen's forehead.
This is so angry!
"Senior Sister Jiang Yun, after my fiancée plotted against me, my family was ruined, and my talent was destroyed, how could I still see the current situation clearly? But this time, Senior Sister Jiang Yun, whether you believe it or not, my heart will not change.
Senior Sister Jiang Yun, there is no need to say more about this matter. Ning'er is my sister, and I will protect her well throughout my life. "
Jiang Chen pondered for a moment, his eyes became a little deeper and his tone was firm.
"Jiang Chen, you - you are simply, oh, forget it, you are right, you have your choice. If you can change, you won't be you anymore."
Jiang Yun sighed feebly, unable to hide the disappointment in her beautiful eyes.
"Jiang Chen, if you have any difficulties in the future, please come to me. As you said, I am not only your senior sister, but also your cousin."
"Although you were expelled from the sect and the family, you will always be my younger brother, Jiang Yun."
Jiang Yun sighed again, stretched out her hand, and gently touched Jiang Chen's face.
Jiang Yun actually felt that Jiang Chen's face was extremely soft, as if it could be broken by a blow, and it was extremely comfortable!
She couldn't help but stroke her twice more.
"Sister, it's not good for you to take advantage of me like this."
Jiang Chen smiled.
"Pfft——"
Jiang Yun suddenly laughed, then reached out and poked Jiang Chen's forehead, and said with a smile: "Jiang Chen, I didn't expect you to be able to make fun of my sister, but it's good. It feels very cordial. It's not like before, when we always felt that we were far apart."
Although Jiang Yun was a little embarrassed to be exposed, because she laughed, her relationship with Jiang Chen immediately became much closer.
Perhaps, subconsciously, she didn't like that kind of serious preaching.
Jiang Chen also smiled and said: "Senior sister, although you are already very charming when you are not smiling, you are even more beautiful when you smile. So, senior sister, you'd better smile more."
Hearing this, Jiang Yun glared at Jiang Chen fiercely again and said: "Glib talk! It seems that you have recovered from your injuries and have really... come out of the past. This is good. In the future, there will beIf you don’t understand anything, just ask me! If you don't mind the eyes of others, I will take you to Tianjian Sect and guide you in your cultivation every day. "
Jiang Chen smiled and said: "Forget it about Tianjian Sect. Senior sister, if you don’t understand anything, why not ask me, I will guide you well. "
"Jiang Chen, you are still bragging, is this really good? "
"Senior sister...even though I haven't practiced for three years, my understanding is still there after all. Senior sister can't look down on me. "
"However, your senior sister and I have now entered the second major field of cultivation - the martial arts true elixir field, and have reached the fourth level of True Yuan Realm. Brother Jiang Chen, how are you going to teach me? "
Jiang Chen frowned slightly and said, "The second major area of cultivation? "
Jiang Yun explained: "Yes, this is the knowledge I gained after entering the True Essence Realm. Cultivation is divided into two major areas by the truly strong, namely the entry-level field for warriors and the field of true martial arts elixirs. For example, the previous acquired warrior realm and the innate purple energy realm belong to the entry-level realm of warriors.
Realms such as True Yuan Realm and Tian Yuan Realm belong to the realm of martial arts and true elixirs. However, in the martial arts true elixir realm, there are not only the true element realm and the Tianyuan realm, but also the virtual elixir realm and other realms. I don’t know the details. "
